---
title: Mixamo Dance Animations
description: FBX motion sources from the final Pippa album animation
---

Build `//third_party/co_huggingface_tanish434_mixamo:dances` for the 41
Mixamo FBX sources used in the final Pippa album, including Inferno. The
pins identify the exact sequence variants from the production files.

Import the FBX motions in Blender and retarget them to the destination rig.
The [Hugging Face dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tanish434/Mixamo-Animations-Characters)
identifies its files as subject to the [Adobe Mixamo terms](https://community.adobe.com/questions-696/mixamo-faq-licensing-royalties-ownership-eula-and-tos-589400).
The target fetches the clips for local use.
